# G-Dimension

> G-Dimension is a car mod tracker, build journal, and vehicle service history log for car enthusiasts: one place to record every modification, part, service, receipt, and photo for each of your cars in a permanent, searchable record, and share a clean public build profile.

G-Dimension (gdimension.app) is a free web app (PWA). Owners document their cars privately, including modifications with specs and costs, maintenance and service history, and a chronological build timeline. They can optionally publish a public build profile at `https://gdimension.app/builds/{username}` showing the car's identity, build sheet (parts and specs, never costs unless the owner opts in), timeline, and photos. Financial records, documents, VINs, and license plates are always private.

## What it is called

People look for this kind of tool under several names. G-Dimension is all of them:

- car mod tracker / vehicle mod tracker / car modification tracker
- car build journal / build log app / build sheet app
- vehicle service history tracker / car maintenance log app
- project car app / restoration build tracker
- car enthusiast garage app

## What you can log

- **Modifications** with brand, part number, category, specs, cost, install date, mileage, photos, and the receipt. Grouped into a build sheet across Power, Chassis, Exterior, and Interior.
- **Maintenance and service history**: scheduled service, repairs, shop invoices with parts and labor separated, mileage at time of service, and receipts.
- **Detailing sessions** as their own log.
- **Parts** you own but have not installed yet (Parts Bin), plus a wishlist of what is next.
- **Timeline entries**: free-form dated notes with photos and links, so a build reads in the order it actually happened.
- **Documents**: registration, insurance, and other records (always private).
- **Export**: a complete build sheet PDF of the car to hand to a buyer.

## How it differs from the alternatives

- **Instagram and forum threads** are reverse-chronological and built for conversation. G-Dimension organizes by car, in the order the work happened, and stays searchable for years.
- **Carfax and similar history reports** cover factory service records. They know nothing about a build: the mods, the parts, or the work the owner did.
- **Notes apps and spreadsheets** have no structure for parts, specs, receipts, or a timeline.

- [Home / product overview](https://gdimension.app/): what G-Dimension is, features, FAQ, and signup
- [Car build sheet guide](https://gdimension.app/build-sheet): what a car build sheet is, what belongs on one, a worked example, and how to generate one

- [Service history for a modified car](https://gdimension.app/service-history): what vehicle history reports capture and miss, and how to keep a service record for a car maintained outside the dealer network

- [Terms of Service](https://gdimension.app/terms): the terms governing use of the service

## Public build profiles

Owner-published build pages are public and need no login. Each build has up to five pages:

- `https://gdimension.app/builds/{username}` — the build profile hub
- `https://gdimension.app/builds/{username}/garage` — the car's identity and specs
- `https://gdimension.app/builds/{username}/buildsheet` — every installed modification by name
- `https://gdimension.app/builds/{username}/timeline` — the build history in order
- `https://gdimension.app/builds/{username}/featured` — the owner's written feature story

These pages are server-rendered for crawlers, so their content is readable without executing JavaScript.

## Optional

- [robots.txt](https://gdimension.app/robots.txt): crawler policy (AI crawlers welcome)
- [Sitemap](https://gdimension.app/sitemap.xml): every public page, including all public build profiles
